name: Yuuenchi - C love r -
source:
One day, you receive a ticket to an amusement park.
Thing is, you've never heard of that particular park before.
This ticket is the key to your one-of-a-kind adventure.
While in another world, will you find friendship, love,
or maybe... the truth?

[translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/11290]Freem![/url]]
translation:
有一天，你收到一张游乐园的门票。
问题是，你以前从未听说过那个特定的公园。
这张门票是你开启独一无二的冒险之旅的钥匙。
在另一个世界，你会找到友情，爱情，
或者也许……真相？

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/11290]Freem![/url]]
